cosmetica-personal.titulo: Great formulation starts with great sourcing
intro: Formulating personal care in Colombia means answering to a consumer who reads the INCI label, asks for natural origin, and compares you against global brands — often at volumes the large importers simply won't bother with. Then come the everyday pains of the trade: references that disappear without warning, batches that arrive different from the last one, and import lead times that never line up with your launch calendar. The right ingredient, backed by reliable data, is half the formula.

That's why we built a portfolio of 120 personal care raw materials: botanical extracts, emollients, humectants, actives, mild surfactants, and the thickeners that hold your texture together. Every shipment leaves with a technical data sheet (TDS), a safety data sheet (SDS), and the batch certificate of analysis (CoA), and you can evaluate samples in your own formula before you buy. If you're torn between two emollients or need to replace a reference, message us on WhatsApp: you'll get an advisor who understands formulation, not a sales script.

retos.texto: The emulsion that's perfect in the lab can break after three months in a hot climate. We help you choose emulsifiers, thickeners, and antioxidants compatible with your system, and we share the technical data sheet (TDS) of the actual batch from the quote onward so you can validate before scaling up.

retos.titulo: Natural, without surprises in the formula
retos.texto: Consumers ask for natural origin, but the wrong extract shifts color, odor, and preservation. With 20 botanical extracts and 9 vegetable oils in the catalog, we guide you on compatibility and use levels, with the manufacturer's documentation as the single source of truth.

retos.titulo: When your importer discontinues your emollient
retos.texto: Few things stall a production run like an ingredient nobody brings in anymore. We look for functional equivalents among our manufacturers, send you a sample with its documentation, and you compare it against your own standard before committing to a purchase.

cosmetica-personal.regulatorio: Every cosmetic sold in Colombia needs a Notificación Sanitaria Obligatoria (mandatory health notification) before INVIMA, under Decisiones 516 and 833 of the CAN (Andean Community). We don't file the paperwork for you, but we do hand over the supporting documents for every raw material — composition, manufacturer documentation, use restrictions — so you can build your dossier with sound judgment.

maquillaje-color.titulo: Exact color is never an accident
intro: Makeup is the least forgiving category in cosmetics: customers notice a shade that shifted between purchases, an eyeshadow that won't set, a lipstick that bleeds. Reproducing color demands well-characterized pigments, carefully controlled dispersions, and a rheology that holds from pilot batch to production line — no small feat when every pigment batch can vary and independent regional brands compete against multinationals with labs of their own.

Our makeup catalog brings together 35 references: pigments and colorants, pearlescents and effect materials, silicone alternatives, emollients, and waxes that add body and slip. Every batch travels with its certificate of analysis (CoA), so your quality control releases color against data instead of memory. Request samples to adjust the shade in your own base, and use WhatsApp for what the catalog can't answer: compatibilities, dosage ranges, or that hard-to-find reference you've been chasing for weeks.

retos.titulo: Reproducing the shade, batch after batch
retos.texto: Pigments vary from batch to batch, and that variation shows up in the finished product. We deliver a certificate of analysis (CoA) with every batch shipped, and we recommend evaluating a sample against your color standard before each large purchase.

retos.titulo: Sensory feel without leaning on silicones
retos.texto: The market asks for formulas with fewer silicones, but consumers won't forgive the loss of slip. We carry 6 silicone alternatives and 9 emollients to rebuild that feel, with samples and documentation so you can benchmark against your current formula.

retos.titulo: The right colorant for each application zone
retos.texto: Not every colorant is suitable for lips or the eye area: Andean regulation restricts use by application zone. We share the manufacturer's documentation for each pigment so you can verify its regulatory status before you formulate, not after.

maquillaje-color.regulatorio: INVIMA classifies makeup as a cosmetic, so it requires a Notificación Sanitaria Obligatoria (mandatory health notification); on top of that, its colorants must comply with the permitted lists in Andean regulation (Decisión 833). We point you to the documentation for each pigment so you can verify its status, though the filing remains your company's responsibility.

aseo-hogar.titulo: Cost per liter is decided in the formula
intro: In home care the battle is fought in cents: fast-moving categories, shoppers who compare price per liter, and retail chains that demand their margin. The formulator spends every day optimizing active matter without losing perceived performance — the foam, the fragrance, the shine users equate with clean — while surfactant prices rise and fall with the international market and hard water across much of the country complicates any formula.

Our portfolio of 53 home care raw materials covers the whole formula: surfactants, degreasers, biocides and disinfectants, acidulants, chelating agents for hard water, and thickeners to dial in the viscosity of the finished product. We quote fast over WhatsApp — a stopped filling line doesn't wait — and every delivery arrives with the complete batch documentation: technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS), and certificate of analysis (CoA). If you're reformulating to bring cost down, request samples of the alternatives, talk to your advisor, and decide with data from your own lab.

retos.texto: Reformulating to reduce cost per liter is the daily bread of this category. With 15 surfactants and 11 degreasers in the catalog, we put alternatives in front of you with their technical data sheet (TDS) and samples, so the savings get validated in the lab and not in the complaints inbox.

The water in many Colombian plants and households carries calcium and magnesium that deactivate surfactants and dull the result. Our chelating agents and acidulants help protect the formula, and the working dose is always confirmed against each manufacturer's technical data sheet (TDS).

Saying "disinfects" or "kills 99.9%" demands evidence that starts at the raw material. Our 8 biocides and disinfectants arrive with the manufacturer's documentation — use concentrations, declared spectrum — so your team can build the support for its own claims.

aseo-hogar.regulatorio: Household hygiene products are notified to INVIMA under Decisión 706 of the CAN (Andean Community), and disinfectants with biocidal action carry additional requirements. Our role is to guide you and hand over the supporting documents for every input — we don't file registrations and we don't promise approvals.

institucional-industrial.titulo: Professional cleaning is formulated, not improvised
intro: Anyone formulating professional cleaning products in Colombia fights the same battle every day: cost per diluted liter against what the customer actually perceives while cleaning. Then come hard water that punishes the formula, raw materials whose availability shifts from one quarter to the next, and institutional buyers — hospitals, food plants, cleaning contractors — who demand documentary support for every input. In this business the margin is defended in the formula, not on the price list.

For that trade we assembled a portfolio of 70 raw materials: surfactants, degreasers, biocides, chelating agents, thickeners, and pH regulators, from the economy all-purpose cleaner to the institutional-grade line. Every shipment leaves with the technical data sheet (TDS), the safety data sheet (SDS), and the batch certificate of analysis (CoA), and you can evaluate samples in your own lab before committing to a purchase. On the other end of WhatsApp is an advisor who understands cleaning chemistry — not a call center.

retos.texto: Institutional cleaning is bought on cost-in-use, not list price. Our surfactants and thickeners give you options to concentrate the formula, and samples let you validate every adjustment before scaling it to production.

A discontinued surfactant can stall an entire line. We help you evaluate substitutes with sound judgment: the manufacturer's data sheet, a sample for your lab, and an honest comparison of specifications — without promising equivalences the batch can't back up.

Your institutional customers audit what you buy. Every batch shipped travels with its safety data sheet (SDS) under the SGA (Colombia's GHS-aligned system), in Spanish, and its certificate of analysis (CoA), so your traceability holds up to the auditor's visit without last-minute emails.

institucional-industrial.regulatorio: Household cleaning and hygiene products and disinfectants require health notification or registration before INVIMA, and their inputs must be handled with a safety data sheet (SDS) under the SGA (Decreto 1496 de 2018, Colombia's GHS-aligned system). We hand you the supporting documents for every raw material and guide you as you build the dossier — the filing is yours, but you don't face it blind.

alimentos.titulo: From the lab to the shelf, ingredients with traceability
intro: Formulating food in Colombia has become a balancing act: front-of-pack warning labels push you to cut sugar and sodium, consumers ask for cleaner labels, and the cost of imported hydrocolloids gives no relief. Every reformulation puts texture, shelf life, and process on the line, and all of it has to stand up before INVIMA with the ingredient's documentation. The challenge is no longer finding additives: it's finding the one that works in your matrix, with the supporting documents complete.

Our portfolio for this industry brings together 63 raw materials: gums and hydrocolloids, thickeners, preservatives, antioxidants, sweeteners, acidulants, proteins, and botanical extracts. You request the sample, you test it in your own matrix, and only then do we talk volumes; each batch's documentation — technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS), and certificate of analysis (CoA) — travels with the order. The presentations we publish are reference presentations and are confirmed depending on the manufacturer and batch, and the quote goes through WhatsApp with an advisor who knows the portfolio.

retos.texto: Cutting sugar and sodium without losing body means pairing sweeteners with gums and thickeners that give the texture back. We offer documented alternatives and samples to test in your matrix, because every food system behaves differently.

Hydrocolloids are sensitive to the origin and the process of each manufacturer. We confirm the batch's technical data sheet (TDS) before the sale and tell you if a specification changes, so your production floor never finds out the hard way.

Consumers ask for recognizable ingredients, but natural also has to be stable and viable on cost. Our botanical extracts arrive with the manufacturer's documentation, so you can evaluate the trend on data rather than on enthusiasm.

alimentos.regulatorio: Processed foods require health registration, permit, or notification before INVIMA according to their risk level, and front-of-pack labeling is governed by Resolución 810 de 2021 and its amendments. We guide you with the supporting documents for each ingredient so you can build your dossier with sound judgment; the filing remains yours.

bebidas.titulo: Flavor isn't the hard part — stability is
intro: A beverage forgives very little: the pulp that settles out, the color that fades on the shelf, the aftertaste that shows up once you cut the sugar for the front-of-pack labels. Beverage formulators in Colombia work with low-pH systems, demanding thermal processes, and a climate that puts any claim to stability to the test. And the boom in botanical and functional drinks has raised the bar: now the ingredient also has to tell a story, with documents to back it up.

For that work we gathered 31 selected raw materials: gums and hydrocolloids for body and suspension, acidulants, sweeteners, colorants, preservatives, and botanical extracts. The first step is always a sample tested in your own beverage, not a catalog promise. After that, every batch arrives with its technical data sheet (TDS), the safety data sheet (SDS) in Spanish, and the certificate of analysis (CoA), in presentations we confirm depending on the manufacturer and batch. Your WhatsApp advisor stays with you through the whole process, from quote to shipment.

retos.titulo: Suspension that holds through shelf life
retos.texto: Keeping pulp or solids suspended for the entire shelf life is a rheology problem, not a matter of luck. Our gums and hydrocolloids come with the manufacturer's data sheet and samples so you can dial in the dose on your actual process.

Take out the sugar and the drink turns thin, with an aftertaste. Pairing sweeteners with the right thickeners helps bring the body back, and every alternative comes documented so your team decides on bench results, not on brochures.

retos.titulo: Color that holds up in the tropics
retos.texto: Light, heat, and acidic pH punish colorants, natural ones most of all. We help you compare options with the manufacturer's specifications in hand and validate with a sample before committing a production run.

bebidas.regulatorio: Beverages are registered with INVIMA according to their category and risk level, and front-of-pack warning labeling applies to them as well. We help you gather the supporting documentation for each ingredient — composition, manufacturer certificates, permitted uses — and you handle the registration yourself, with the folder complete.

nutraceutico.titulo: Ingredients that back up what your label declares
intro: The nutraceutical market in Colombia and across the region is growing faster than consumer trust, and that gap closes with documentary evidence: anyone formulating a dietary supplement knows that every vitamin, every amino acid, and every extract has to arrive with verifiable potency, because the label becomes a promise — to INVIMA and to the end customer. Add actives that are sensitive to heat and humidity, difficult matrices (gummies, instant powders, beverages), and consumers who read the ingredient list with a magnifying glass.

Our nutraceutical portfolio brings together 30 references: vitamins, proteins and amino acids, antioxidants, sweeteners, and gums for body and stability. Every shipment leaves with the certificate of analysis (CoA) for its batch, and you can evaluate lab samples in your own formula before committing to a purchase. If you have questions about grade, solubility, or compatibility, we work through them on WhatsApp with an advisor who knows the portfolio — the presentations are reference presentations and are confirmed depending on the manufacturer and batch.

retos.texto: Vitamins lose activity with time, heat, and humidity. That's why we deliver the certificate of analysis (CoA) for the actual batch — not typical catalog values — along with the manufacturing date and the storage conditions, so your quality control releases on data.

Proteins and botanical extracts tend to bring bitter or earthy notes that consumers won't forgive. We combine sweeteners and gums that help build profile and texture, and we ship samples so you can tune the sensory profile in your own matrix before scaling up.

A dietary supplement is registered with supporting documents for every ingredient. We help you gather the manufacturer's documentation — composition, certificates, specifications — so that building your dossier doesn't hold up the launch. The filing is yours; the documents and the judgment are on us.

nutraceutico.regulatorio: Dietary supplements and foods require health registration or notification before INVIMA according to their category. We guide you on the supporting documents each raw material contributes to your dossier; the filing before the authority is carried out by your company.

veterinaria.titulo: From premix to finished feed, with no loose links
intro: In animal production, feed is the line item that decides profitability, and anyone formulating finished feed or premixes knows it: a badly dosed micronutrient or a degraded vitamin doesn't show up on the scale at dispatch — it shows up weeks later in the barn or in the pond. On top of that technical pressure sit the volatility of imported materials, the timelines of ICA registration, and livestock customers who expect consistent results, cycle after cycle.

Our animal nutrition line brings together 50 references across veterinary premixes, vitamins, amino acids, acidulants, preservatives, and enzymes, designed for feed mills, veterinary laboratories, and production nuclei. We work with a certificate of analysis (CoA) per batch and the manufacturing date in plain sight, we send samples for your mixing trials, and a technical advisor stays with you on WhatsApp from the quote through the restock. The published presentations are reference presentations: we always confirm against the data sheet of the available batch.

retos.titulo: Vitamins that stay stable inside the premix
retos.texto: Trace minerals, humidity, and time in storage degrade the vitamins in a premix. We deliver a certificate of analysis (CoA) and the manufacturing date for every batch, and we recommend presentations matched to your real turnover so you don't pay for potency that dies on the shelf.

The livestock industry is moving toward programs with reduced antibiotic use, and that puts acidulants, enzymes, and preservatives at the center of the formulation. We ship samples with their documentation so your technical team can evaluate them in their own diets and conditions.

retos.titulo: Supply that doesn't stop the mill
retos.texto: A feed mill can't shut down because an imported material ran late. We carry equivalent references from different manufacturers and put the technical data sheet (TDS) of each alternative in front of you, so your quality team decides on the substitution with data instead of against the clock.

veterinaria.regulatorio: Animal feed, additives, and other livestock inputs are registered with the ICA. We help you understand what manufacturer's supporting documentation your dossier needs; the registration itself is filed by your company.

agricola.titulo: Documented plant nutrition, from the lab to the field
intro: Formulating for Colombian agriculture means formulating for many countries at once: acidic soils on the highland plateau, hard water in the valleys, crops that range from technified coffee to export flowers. A foliar fertilizer that works in one region precipitates in the tank in another, and the grower doesn't distinguish between a bad input and a bad tank mix — he simply doesn't buy again. Add ICA registrations that take their time and imported raw materials whose prices change between one quote and the next.

For that terrain we assembled 33 references: a strong plant nutrition base — 19 products — plus chelating agents, adjuvants, acidulants, and surfactants to complete the formula. Before you buy a single kilo you can review the batch's technical data sheet (TDS) and request samples for your compatibility and field trials. And when the crop can't wait, neither can the quote: message us on WhatsApp and an advisor who speaks your technical language answers during business hours.

retos.texto: The pH of the soil and of the water decides whether a micronutrient reaches the plant or settles at the bottom of the tank. Our chelating agents and acidulants give you the tools to formulate stable mixes, and each batch's technical data sheet (TDS) tells you exactly what you're working with.

retos.titulo: Every droplet has to reach the target
retos.texto: A well-formulated agrochemical is wasted if the droplet bounces, runs off, or evaporates. With adjuvants and surfactants you tune the wetting, adhesion, and penetration of your mixes; we send samples with documentation so you can validate them in your own bioassays.

Registering a fertilizer or a soil conditioner demands precise supporting documents for every raw material: composition, origin, manufacturer's specifications. We gather that documentation with you from the very first purchase, so the paperwork travels with the product instead of chasing it.

agricola.regulatorio: Fertilizers, soil conditioners, and other agricultural inputs require registration with the ICA. We don't file paperwork on your behalf, but we do guide you on the manufacturer's supporting documents your dossier is going to need.

pinturas-recubrimientos.titulo: From pigment to final gloss, with no batch surprises
intro: Anyone who formulates paint in Colombia knows it: color doesn't forgive. A pigment that changes supplier, a solvent that arrives at a different purity, or a discontinued dispersant forces you to reformulate against the clock, while the customer expects the same shade and the same dry time as always. And all of it with an exchange rate that moves the cost of imported materials from one quarter to the next. Formulating well isn't enough: you have to be able to repeat it.

For that trade we assembled a portfolio of 21 raw materials: solvents, pigments and colorants, dispersants and defoamers, rheology modifiers, and pearlescents for effect finishes. Every shipment leaves with a technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS), and the batch certificate of analysis (CoA), and you can evaluate samples in your own formula before committing to a purchase. An advisor who knows the line answers you on WhatsApp: quotes, availability, and the hard-to-find reference when it comes up.

retos.texto: The same color index can behave differently depending on the manufacturer and batch. That's why we work with reference presentations and reference specifications, confirm the batch's technical data sheet (TDS) before selling, and ship with a certificate of analysis (CoA) so your quality control releases against real data.

When an additive leaves the market, the reformulation is on you — but the search doesn't have to be. We propose functional equivalents from our portfolio, send samples with their technical documentation, and stay with you through validation before the change scales to production.

retos.titulo: Solvents with their paperwork in order

textil.titulo: Auxiliary chemistry that respects the fiber and the process
intro: The Colombian textile industry competes against the world with wet processes that leave no room for improvisation: a half-done scouring stains the dyeing, a poorly degreased bath shows up meters later, and every reprocess costs water, energy, and machine shifts. Add auxiliaries that change supplier without warning and the mounting pressure for cleaner processes. On the plant floor, the difference between an approved lot and a rejected one usually starts in the auxiliary chemistry.

Our textile portfolio brings together 17 raw materials for wet processing: surfactants and degreasers for preparation, enzymes and chelating agents for more stable baths, biocides for preservation, and conditioners and silicones for finishing. Everything arrives with a technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS), and the batch certificate of analysis (CoA), and you can request samples to run your own process trials before buying. Quoting, availability, and follow-up all run through WhatsApp, with an advisor who speaks the language of the dyehouse.

retos.texto: The knitting oils and sizes that don't come off during preparation reappear as defects in the dyeing. Our surfactants and degreasers arrive with specifications documented per batch, and you can evaluate them on samples over your own substrate before changing the bath recipe.

Iron and water hardness destabilize bleaching and produce uneven dyeing. A well-chosen chelating agent protects the bath, and we help you choose it: a technical data sheet (TDS) from the quote onward, a sample for your lab trial, and the same material, documented, on every restock.

Not every dyehouse goes through full drums. We work with reference presentations, confirmed depending on the manufacturer and batch, and we look for the pack size that matches your real consumption — from the lab trial to production — so that inventory doesn't turn into idle capital or expired product.

textil.regulatorio: Textile wet processes answer for their discharges under Resolución 631 de 2015, and every industrial input is handled under the SGA (Decreto 1496 de 2018, Colombia's GHS-aligned system). We hand you the safety data sheets (SDS) in Spanish and the manufacturer's supporting documents so your environmental and safety teams work with complete information — permits and characterizations remain your operation's territory.

tratamiento-aguas.titulo: Compliant water starts with the right dosing
intro: Running a treatment plant allows no pauses: the water comes in every day, whether or not the influent quality shifts, rain or dry season. Running out of coagulant, of pH regulator, or of biocide isn't a commercial inconvenience — it's a parameter out of spec, a compromised discharge, or a cooling tower at risk. And in Colombia, the demands on every cubic meter treated only move in one direction: up.

Our line for treatment plants brings together 27 raw materials: acidulants and pH regulators, polymers for flocculation, chelating agents and dispersants for cooling systems and boilers, biocides for microbiological control, and degreasers for maintenance. Every batch travels with a technical data sheet (TDS), safety data sheet (SDS), and certificate of analysis (CoA); there are samples for your jar tests; and there's a WhatsApp advisor who understands dosing — and the urgency of a plant that can't stop.

retos.texto: A wastewater treatment plant (PTAR) without inputs is out of compliance the next day. We work with fast quoting over WhatsApp, shipments to the country's main cities, and scheduled deliveries for plants with recurring consumption, so that the restock arrives before the chemical tank starts screaming for it.

The optimal dose depends on the batch's actual concentration, not on the typical value in the catalog. That's why every shipment includes its certificate of analysis (CoA), and you can request samples to fine-tune the jar test before committing the month's consumption.

A downpour, a process change upstream, or a dry season alters the influent and throws the chemistry off. Our portfolio covers several treatment routes — coagulation, pH adjustment, microbiological control — and your advisor helps you weigh alternatives with their technical data sheets (TDS) in hand.

tratamiento-aguas.regulatorio: Point discharges to water bodies and to sewer systems are measured against Resolución 631 de 2015, and water for human consumption answers to Resolución 2115 de 2007. We guide you with the safety data sheets (SDS) and the manufacturer's supporting documents for every input so you can substantiate your operation before the environmental authority — characterizations and permits remain your plant's responsibility.
